title: POST /api/decks/:id/reorder-for-stage (D1561, #3808)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `deckActions` method passes through: Reorder for stage (`routes/deck_actions.ts`). Either the new version (`deck`) with the stage it was ordered for, how many cards moved and `one_undo_step: true`; or `unchanged: true` with `moved: 0` when the cards were already in that order and nothing was written. D1511 (#3762).
